title: Prototype (2024)
headline: The proof of Remark 3 has a gap that a short argument repairs. A related gap in Lemma 4(b) is confirmed for the 2024 appendix but unresolved for the revised appendix, which could not be obtained.

claims.label: Remark 3
claims.gist: Price paths that are optimal for finite horizons stay optimal in the limit.
claims.statement: If a price path is optimal for every finite horizon, its limit is optimal for the infinite-horizon problem.
conditions: patient buyers with discount factor below one

result.summary: The proof assumes the limit path exists; a short compactness argument supplies it.
result.witness: The argument passes to the limit without showing that the finite-horizon paths converge. A compactness argument on bounded paths closes the gap.
result.tested: The proof read line by line; horizons up to twelve periods checked numerically.
not_claimed: Remark 3 is not claimed to be false.
result.repair_note: A compactness argument closes the gap in all cases checked.

vor_check.detail: Statement and definitions checked on rendered pages; the proof compared in extracted text only.

checks.detail: The researcher checked the limit argument by hand.
A separate AI session confirmed the missing step.

reproduction.detail: The evidence package reruns with one command (Python 3.12, standard library only).

claims.novelty: No earlier report found in the searched literature.

claims.label: Lemma 4(b) (online appendix)
claims.gist: Optimal prices never rise after the first sale.
claims.statement: In every optimal price path, the price never increases after the first period with a sale.

result.summary: Same gap as Remark 3 in the 2024 appendix; the revised appendix could not be obtained.
result.detail: In the 2024 online appendix the proof has the same missing limit step as Remark 3. The journal posted a revised appendix in 2026, which could not be obtained; it may already address the gap.
result.limits: Not counted as a defect until the revised appendix has been checked.

vor_check.detail: Only the 2024 appendix was available; the 2026 revision could not be obtained.

reproduction.detail: The evidence package reruns with one command (Python 3.12, standard library only).

history.label: Gap in Remark 3 reproduced by the researcher

statements.ai_use: Discovery and the separate rechecks used AI models in separate sessions. The independent reproduction, the version-of-record check and every editorial decision were done by the researcher.
